title: Notebook run status
description: Keep waiting on a notebook run that notebooks-run started, and write each cell's result into the document as it lands. Waits up to ~45s per call, so call it again while the status is still 'running'. Safe to repeat: a result already in the document is not written a second time. Returns the same shape as notebooks-run, including which cell stopped the run. A cell edited since the run started still receives the frozen code's result, so its rows and its code can disagree.
